page.layout: One printed page of verse, one column of italic lines, centred on the page; no margin notes. Catchword "Pocula" at lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: „Nam neque nos vento, pelagique erroribus acti

p.i: Venimus huc, coeli sed ineluctabilis ordo
Te petere, inque tuis iussit considere Regnis,
Cede Deo, simul haec simul ingens undique clamor
Nauticus, assensu respondant aequora rauco
Et iam deductae siccum insedere carinae.
Continuo littus superis ingressus amicis
Magnanimus Ligur, optatae dedit oscula Terrae,
Deinde polum aspectans inflexo poplite fatur.
Quas tibi, quas tanto referam pro munere grates
Summe Pater? Tu me penitus nil tale merentem
Qui nomen, ritusque tuos transcognita ferrem
Sydera legisti, tantumque audere didisti,
Tu mulces venti rabiem, tu seaua coerces
Monstra Erebi classemque tumentibus aequoris undis
Ereptam toties felici in littore sistis,
Ah ne forte tuam mea nunc facta impia mentem
Auertant, sed dexter ades, sed dirige fessos
Ignarosque viae, rerumque exordia firma.
Dixerat, & victae monumenta insignia mortis
Quadrifidum ingentem transuerso stipite truncum
Sublimi in tumulo tolli iubet, ocyus omnes
Incumbunt operi, cuneisque immania findunt
Robora, nec requies, donec venerabile signum
Educunt coelo, & spumanti in littore figunt:
Corpora dehinc longo curant exhausta labore,
Concussisque famem arboribus solantur, & herba,
Pocula

page.notes: The catchword "Pocula" is set at the lower right; the first line's opening quotation mark is uncertain and may be a printed initial N ligature. Some letters in the italic display are doubtful (e.g. "seaua" as printed). No page number or running head is printed.
